items.title: Dick Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 1, 2006
items.q: So what if somebody said ‘Adolph Hitler?’

ctx.x: Yeah. Interesting. Yeah I think it was another Bill Crow story about Bobby Hackett selling one of his trumpets and he said “high register never used.”

That’s right. And somebody once said to him, and this was on a radio interview, “Bobby you’re known for never having a bad word about anybody. Praise, yes, but you’ll never criticize anybody. So what if somebody said ‘Adolph Hitler?’” So Bobby thinks a minute and he says, “Well I guess you’d have to say that he was tops in his line.”
Wow. Well one thing you said about the band and this CD, our jazz does not rely on arrangements or even preparatory discussions before we swing into a tune.
